title: Uncertainty About Malfunctions and Vehicle Features
summary: This topic is dominated by uncertain statements about possible malfunctions, feature operation, and whether issues affected vehicle behavior, with only a few clearly positive or negative remarks.

positive.summary: The only positive example expresses broad enjoyment of the vehicle rather than a specific feature or fix.

negative.summary: Negative remarks describe suspected malfunctions, recurring-problem concern, and uncertainty about the cause of a vehicle issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined remarks mainly reflect customer uncertainty about vehicle functions, equipment, timing, preconditioning, and whether symptoms affected performance.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so clear customer sentiment is limited.
The cluster mixes suspected faults with general uncertainty about feature operation, scheduling, and usage questions.
The positive sample is too limited to identify a concrete positive aspect beyond general enjoyment.
